refs.author: see Commons file page
refs.note: Aquarium close-up (public aquarium), fish slightly turned toward the viewer (a near-lateral, not exact); rotated 6.5 deg clockwise about the peduncle centre so snout and peduncle sit level. All px are in that levelled 1920x1080 copy. By-eye annotation about +-15 px (1% of length); the pelvic and pectoral fins are not distinguishable in this photo and are not drawn. The photo saturates the blue and tints the yellow olive: colours come from the previous plan; fins keep flat tints (no colour grid).

frame.note: px -> card: u = (x - xTail)/W, v = (y - yAxis)/W, W = xSnout - xTail (total length).

thickness.note: No front or top photo and no cited figure; the existing 0.30 is kept, 3D front and top views are NOT claimed validated.

look.note: Colours carried from the previous plan (the photo saturates the blue); the dark eye line is a body-relative ribbon read off the photo.
